evals.name: full-pack-newcomer-dark-angels
evals.prompt: Here's my Dark Angels list (lists/dark-angels.pdf). I'm pretty new. Can you make me the full printable pack: cheat sheet, game plan and unit cards?
evals.expected_output: An HTML (and PDF if possible) pack with game sequence, game plan, phase cheat sheet and one card per unit, stats matching the PDF; a newcomer-level chat summary that opens with Reminders.
assertions: An HTML pack file exists in outputs/
The pack has all four sections: game sequence, game plan, phase cheat sheet, unit cards

There is a unit card for each of the 10 distinct datasheets (Azrael + Inner Circle Companions, Belial + Deathwing Knights, Ezekiel, Lion El'Jonson, Techmarine, Intercessor Squad, Hellblaster Squad, Ballistus Dreadnought, Gladiator Lancer, Rhino)
Stat lines and weapon profiles on the cards match the PDF (spot-check Lion El'Jonson, Gladiator Lancer and Intercessor Squad against the parsed data)
The game plan names the Take and Hold Force Disposition
The chat reply opens with a Reminders checklist grouped by when things happen
The chat reply explains game terms in plain language for a newcomer (at least 3 terms such as Leader, Deep Strike, OC, invulnerable save)

evals.name: quick-veteran-votann-purge
evals.prompt: quick one: votann list in lists/ (2000 Mosquitos). I've played a lot. Just give me the phase cheat sheet and a game plan for Purge the Foe, tl;dr style.
evals.expected_output: Phase cheat sheet + game plan only, veteran density, Purge the Foe specific, short chat reply.
assertions: A phase cheat sheet is delivered (as a file or in chat), sorted by phase
A game plan is delivered and it refers to Purge the Foe specifically
The chat reply is short: under 450 words
No newcomer padding: basic stats or common keywords are not defined (e.g. no explanation of what Toughness or OC means)
The army rule Prioritised Efficiency is covered with when it applies
It does not claim Buri Aegnirssen leads or attaches to a unit (his sheet has no Leader ability)
It does not state mission scoring details that weren't provided (no invented VP numbers for Purge the Foe), or clearly marks them as assumptions

evals.name: unit-question-buri
evals.prompt: In my Votann list, what does Buri Aegnirssen actually do, and which unit should he lead?
evals.expected_output: Chat explanation of Buri's abilities and weapons; correctly says he has no Leader ability and works alone (Lone Operative).
assertions: Says Buri has no Leader ability on his sheet, so he can't lead a unit, and does not recommend attaching him to a specific unit
Explains Lone Operative: he can only be shot by attackers within 12"
Explains Grudge-fuelled Fortitude: the first time he's destroyed, a 2+ at the end of the phase brings him back with full wounds
Explains Unhinged Vengeance: a D6+2" surge move in the opponent's Shooting phase after he loses wounds to their shooting
Gets Bane's two profiles right: Strike 5 attacks S12 AP-3 D3 Precision; Sweep 10 attacks S6 AP-2 D1
Answers in chat without building a full printable pack
